questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Responsive CSS Fundamentals?
options: It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
one utility expresses one CSS concern or a closely related behavior
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
questions.answer_key: one utility expresses one CSS concern or a closely related behavior
questions.explanation: Responsive CSS Fundamentals is best understood through the syllabus topics: Viewport dimensions, Media queries, Mobile-first design. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with responsive css fundamentals?
options: Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
combine meaningful utilities in markup and verify browser styles
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
questions.answer_key: combine meaningful utilities in markup and verify browser styles
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Viewport dimensions, Media queries, Mobile-first design, Fixed versus fluid dimensions.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying responsive css fundamentals?
options: visual styling does not replace semantic HTML or actual interactive behavior
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
questions.answer_key: visual styling does not replace semantic HTML or actual interactive behavior
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
